summary: Iteration 7 — fully tested Progress Updates + Admin Master Workshop Takeover + Suspend/Unsuspend feature. Added /app/backend/tests/test_takeover_progress.py (23 tests, all pass). Backend covers: ProgressIn validation (422 note<3), non-executor 403, client cannot post progress 403, executor successful post returns updated progress_percent + progress_updates list + client notification created with percent in title, percent cannot decrease (400), percent can increase (200), inactive project (pending_review) → 403 since vendor_id null. Takeover: non-admin 403, reason<10 chars → 422, admin takeover transitions status→internal_takeover, swaps vendor_id→'user_master_workshop', vendor_name→'Master Workshop MatShop', keeps original_vendor_id/name, submitted milestone reverts to 'held', takeover.escrow_transferred = sum held/submitted amounts, remaining_unpaid = sum pending amounts, from_vendor_id set, client receives 'Garansi Penyelesaian Proyek MatShop' notification, defaulting supplier auto-suspended (appears in GET /api/admin/suspended-users), second takeover rejected 400. Post-takeover: admin can post progress and submit milestones acting as Master Workshop; client releases milestone; project detail still exposes original_vendor_id for original vendor view. Suspended-user cannot bid (403); POST /api/admin/users/{uid}/unsuspend restores bidding; unsuspending unknown user → 404. Full regression suite: 128 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing auto_release skip). Playwright E2E: supplier /dashboard?tab=peluang showed won-projects-list with toggle-progress-form-{pid}; opening revealed progress-form/range/percent-input/note-input/submit; submitting 30% rendered progress-bars-{pid} with 30%. Admin /admin → admin-tab-monitor → takeover-board visible with monitor-card and takeover-btn; opening takeover-dialog, filling 10+ char reason + confirm transitioned monitor-status-{pid} to INTERNAL_TAKEOVER; red banner 'Dana escrow Rp 3.600.000 dialihkan ke Master Workshop · sisa belum dibayar Rp 8.400.000' rendered; suspended-user_demo_supplier card appeared; unsuspend-user_demo_supplier click removed from list with 'Akun diaktifkan kembali' toast. Final state verified: GET /api/admin/suspended-users returns [] — demo supplier/designer fully restored.
critical_code_review_comments: custom_projects.add_progress: percent decrease check uses `p.get('progress_percent') or 0` — safely treats initial None as 0. Good.
is_executor() correctly allows admin to act as Master Workshop executor after takeover. Clean centralisation of ownership check.
ensure_active() invoked in add_progress AND milestone_action(actor='vendor') — suspension gating is consistent across all vendor-side actions.
takeover endpoint correctly reverts 'submitted' milestones to 'held' so client doesn't accidentally release funds to the suspended original vendor; escrow_ledger entry created for audit.
milestone_action preserves 'internal_takeover' status when releasing partial milestones (only switches to 'completed' when ALL released). Good state preservation.
GET /custom/projects/{id} allows p['original_vendor_id'] == user.user_id to view — original vendor retains read access post-takeover for transparency. Nice touch.
admin_unsuspend sets suspended=False AND clears suspended_reason — idempotent and clean. 404 on unknown user.
Minor: /api/admin/suspended-users returns full User list (filters only suspended=True); may want pagination for large installs but acceptable for current MVP.
Minor: takeover.info stores 'by: admin.name' (display name) — consider adding admin.user_id for stronger audit trail (same minor as iter6).
ProjectCard renders progress-bars inside both vendor and client lists; ProgressUpdateForm correctly uses project-specific testids (-{project_id}) ensuring selector uniqueness per card.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — progress form, progress bars, takeover dialog, suspended list, unsuspend all verified end-to-end
